11/22/2026
Inside for AM cleaning, very timid on approach, wary of handler, low growling and wide eyed with trembling in back legs, did start to settle for treats offered and accepted gently with head lowered but wary of leash being presented, paced to back of kennel hard staring and low growling with some hard staring if handler slowly came forward to place leash. Dodged leash but able to lasso, exited kennel slowly with easy leash pull to small play yard, startled by reactive dogs in passing and flinches heavily, nub flagged, turns to look at handler throughout walk but no issues walking to yard. In yard dog approached assistant handler immediately with neutral body, sniffed and accepted pets on body, heavily trembling in back legs but alternating between handlers throughout allowing pets all over, gently accepted treats. Flinches heavily when startled by loud noises or activities outside of yard, flinched when bird flew by but returns to handlers for pets, sitting in front of handler with neutral body allowing petting all over. Would stay close to handlers all of evaluation alternating between handlers allowing petting all over and accepting treats, very timid. No issues with return to kennel, easily startled, walked into kennel hesitantly and came forward allowing handler to remove leash by hand.
11/21/2026
Closed inside for AM cleaning. Dog approached handler, calm, stoic, took treats gently. Backed away and flinched when placing leash, slow walk to yard, would frequently look back at handler with whale eyes, easily startled by environment, once in yard attached extended leash as precaution. Dog explored, nose to ground, neutral, approached handler and intently sniffed shoe, took treats gently from hand, continued exploring, slightly evasive as handler walked around, approached when called by name, took more treats, handler sat in chair, dog followed, flinched when initially touched but settled and allowed petting all over, sat at handler's feet scanning surroundings, looked back at handler with soft eyes, took more treats. Followed handler into catch pen, able to attach clip leash, no issues walking back to kennel, hesitant to return, handler stepped in, dog followed with verbal coaxing, dog came forward and allowed handler to slowly remove leash by hand.
11/19/2026
Tense body, trying to duck away while walking into intake. Took hot dogs. Tolerated muzzle wrap to be picked up onto scale. Fear urinated. Skin crawl while scanning for microchip.
